# pluginLynxDebugMetadata

{/* @api PackageHeader package="debug-metadata-rsbuild-plugin" */}

<div className="api-pkg-header"><code>@lynx-js/debug-metadata-rsbuild-plugin</code> <span className="api-pkg-version">v0.2.2</span> · <a href="https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lynx-js/debug-metadata-rsbuild-plugin" target="_blank" rel="noopener">npm</a> · <a href="https://github.com/lynx-family/lynx-stack/tree/main/packages/rspeedy/plugin-debug-metadata" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Source</a> · <a href="https://github.com/lynx-family/lynx-stack/tree/main/packages/rspeedy/plugin-debug-metadata/CHANGELOG.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Changelog</a></div>

{/* @api-end */}

Emits a `debug-metadata.json` next to the bundle with the information Lynx DevTool needs to map runtime errors back to the source. [`pluginLynx`](/rspeedy/plugins/plugin-lynx) applies it by default.

## Installation

import { PackageManagerTabs } from '@rspress/core/theme';

<PackageManagerTabs command="add @lynx-js/debug-metadata-rsbuild-plugin -D" />

## Usage

```ts title="lynx.config.ts"
import { defineConfig } from '@lynx-js/rspeedy'
import { pluginLynxDebugMetadata } from '@lynx-js/debug-metadata-rsbuild-plugin'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [pluginLynxDebugMetadata()],
})
```

## API

{/* @api ApiExports package="debug-metadata-rsbuild-plugin"  */}

## Functions \{#functions\}

### `pluginLynxDebugMetadata()` \{#pluginlynxdebugmetadata\}

```ts
pluginLynxDebugMetadata(): RsbuildPlugin
```

Register `debug-metadata.json` emission for every Lynx template build
and serve sub-field queries via a connect-style dev-server middleware.

Auto-registered by Rspeedy core.

The dev-server middleware exposes these endpoints (relative to each
entry's intermediate dir):

```text
GET .../debug-metadata.json
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=source-map&path=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=source-map&filename=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=source-map&key=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=bytecode-debug-info&filename=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=artifact&filename=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=artifacts
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=ui-source-map
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=buildInfo
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=git
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=rspeedy

GET .../*.js.map    → transparently forwarded to ?field=source-map
GET .../*.css.map   → transparently forwarded to ?field=source-map
```

**Returns:** `RsbuildPlugin`

### `rewriteSourceMappingURLs()` \{#rewritesourcemappingurls\}

```ts
rewriteSourceMappingURLs(compilation: Compilation, args: { chunkGroups: ChunkGroup[]; encodeData: EncodeRawData; filenameTemplate: string; intermediate: string; intermediateAssets: string[] }, options?: RewriteSourceMappingURLsOptions): void
```

Rewrite the `//# sourceMappingURL=...` directive of every JS asset in the
current template to an absolute URL. No-op when `debugMetadataUrl`
(`args.encodeData.sourceContent.config['debugMetadataUrl']`) is unset.

| Parameters | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `compilation` | `Compilation` (from [@rspack/core](https://rspack.rs/config/)) |  |
| `args` | `{ chunkGroups: ChunkGroup[]; encodeData: EncodeRawData; filenameTemplate: string; intermediate: string; intermediateAssets: string[] }` |  |
| `options?` | [`RewriteSourceMappingURLsOptions`](#rewritesourcemappingurlsoptions) |  |

## Constants \{#constants\}

### `DEBUG_METADATA_ASSET_NAME` \{#debug-metadata-asset-name\}

```ts
const DEBUG_METADATA_ASSET_NAME: "debug-metadata.json"
```

Default name of the debug metadata asset emitted alongside each template.

## Types \{#types\}

### `RewriteSourceMappingURLsOptions` \{#rewritesourcemappingurlsoptions\}

Options for [`rewriteSourceMappingURLs`](#rewritesourcemappingurls).

| Members | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="rewritesourcemappingurlsoptions-getsourcemappingurl"></a>`getSourceMappingURL?` | `(info: { debugMetadataUrl: string; mapPath: string }) => string` | Override the URL written into each rewritten sourceMappingURL. Defaults to `${debugMetadataUrl}?field=source-map&path=<encoded mapPath>`. |
